response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.riskeval AS risk, SUM(sc.gbsize) * 1.0 / SUM(sc.spanmin) AS rate FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.riskeval), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS bench FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS avg_rate_above_benchmark, AVG(g.rate - b.bench) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM g, b WHERE b.bench IS NOT NULL AND g.rate > b.bench
